:::{#def-sparse-vector}
#### $k$-sparse vector (sparsity)

For a vector $\vx$ in [$\reals^p$](#def-real-coordinate-space)
and a whole number $k \le p$,
$\vx$ is **$k$-sparse**
[@wikipedia_sparse_matrix]
if at most $k$ of its $p$ entries are nonzero.
A method that favors vectors with fewer nonzero entries promotes **sparsity**.

:::
